results.note: CONNECT with no Proxy-Authorization header is rejected with 407 (ProxyAuthenticationValidatorTest.shouldRejectMissingAndWrongCredential)

base64 is case-sensitive: a case-mutated valid credential is a different credential and is rejected, not silently widened by a case-insensitive comparison (ProxyAuthenticationValidatorTest.shouldRejectCaseMutatedCredential)
an upper-cased valid credential is rejected (ProxyAuthenticationValidatorTest.shouldRejectUpperCasedAndLowerCasedCredential)
a lower-cased valid credential is rejected (ProxyAuthenticationValidatorTest.shouldRejectUpperCasedAndLowerCasedCredential)
a well-formed but wrong credential is rejected (ProxyAuthenticationValidatorTest.shouldRejectMissingAndWrongCredential)
